# Signing in with passkeys

A passkey is a key pair: the private half never leaves the phone or the laptop, and the site keeps only the public half.

## Why no password

There is nothing to type, so there is nothing to steal on a fake login page. A phishing site gets a signature for the wrong domain, which the real site refuses.

## Recovery

Keep two passkeys on two devices. Losing a phone then costs a new key, not the account.
